program.purpose: Standardize how VyrnForge source, generated reference data, executable examples, CI evidence, deployed reference sites, and release snapshots move through one traceable lifecycle before component expansion resumes.

readerSurfaces.role: executable examples, component/pattern exploration, and reference views
readerSurfaces.target: A later reference-product redesign may replace the current shell, but must preserve this delivery, version, framework, and canonical-data contract.

lifecycle.policy: affected-scope validation plus ci-gate on the owning integration lane; reference-affecting PRs also emit a non-deployable immutable preview artifact
full repository validation plus ci-gate before integration lane promotion to main
delivery-only rebuild of docs/playground/reference output bound to the exact main commit and CI run; the same mode may be explicitly dispatched after a release tag exists
consume and verify an immutable successful current-main delivery artifact; never rebuild source in the deployment workflow
full quality/integration, compatibility, security drift, CodeQL, and persistent-lane drift; never publish or deploy

manual current-main release using verified immutable tarballs, trusted publishing, registry verification, release records, then a release-bound delivery dispatch and Pages deployment after the tag exists

artifacts.lineage: exact Git commit + successful current-main CI run + tarball digests

gaps.description: The generated framework API reference is the canonical reader-facing API authority. Playground component readers consume generated framework API facts through referenceMetadata and no longer maintain a competing props-table API source.

Docs and Playground share docs/metadata/reference-portal.json, the same Native HTML/React/Angular/Vue vocabulary, vyrnforge-versions.json version catalog, deep-link context, and deployment/version model while remaining modular applications.

docs/metadata/executable-examples.json binds all four first-class framework identities to the existing packed consumer fixtures in tests/consumers/manifest.json with typecheck, build, and runtime verification evidence.
Reference-affecting PRs emit an immutable non-deployable docs/playground preview artifact bound to the tested commit and CI run; preview jobs retain read-only workflow permissions.

After registry verification creates or verifies the release tag and GitHub prerelease, the controlled release dispatches exact-main CI in delivery mode. That run assembles the tag-aware immutable Pages artifact, then the release dispatches the existing Pages workflow with the exact CI run ID so the tagged snapshot is deployed without another source commit.

requiredBeforeClose: generated API reference is reader-facing and drift-checked
docs and playground share one version/framework/reference contract
representative examples are verified across Native HTML, React, Angular, and Vue
PR reference preview artifact is available without deployment permissions
current-main reference deployment consumes immutable artifacts only
successful release refreshes the exact tagged reference snapshot without another source commit
